display_name: Phase1 fixed physical restoration source L_s union audit

authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CPU fixed predictor; separate CPU source L_s truth-last scorer

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Existing fixed 1047 L_s predictions, no new IQ inference
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Only legitimate source L_s truth after all predictions fixed; no U_s truth, V or test read
data.validation_ref: All L_s RX4/6 source validation and RX8 source holdout day3, physical IDs previously observed

permissions.query_use: Already fixed source L_s predictions and legal L_s truth only; no U_s truth, V or target data
permissions.claim_scope: Source L_s data previously used by ground F and/or prior views; not independent blind or target test

checkpoint.initialization: No training or model inference; reads already fixed source prediction artifacts and source role/label mapping
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: All 1047 source prediction cohorts and common clean/raw/DURA/parent decisions must match before source truth
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: No selection; report nondeployable truth-assisted per-record union of fixed predictions only

execution.launch_owner: Codex source fixed prediction complementarity audit
execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, no new IQ inference
execution.stop_rule: Stop for source provenance/role violations, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failures; do not retry without state reconciliation.

metric_names: source L_s correct counts by method and scenario
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Three existing 1047-record source L_s fixed prediction artifacts
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Truth-assisted union requires unavailable true labels and only describes these fixed candidate outputs and previously explored source IDs; not deployable nor a bound on other methods.

rows.method: source labeled post-hoc union of fixed physical candidates and DURA
rows.purpose: quantify complementary source errors before designing a label-free selector
rows.seed_notes: Frozen direct mixture trained using 4096 other IDs, F previously used these source IDs; no updates.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: No new IQ inference or training.
L_s truth had been read only after fixed predictions in original source audits.
Truth-assisted union is impossible at deployment, not independent or a global upper bound.
